items.en_title: Padre Bernardo (GO) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 2 #(8340) | 14-0
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Padre Bernardo (GO) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 72,000; proposals close Dec 2, 13:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
